title: Ensure Retina-quality image sizing across both themes
description:
Two issues with book/event images:

1. Astro Image components were requesting display-size outputs (140px) causing blur on Retina — fix by requesting 2x display size (partially done for redesign BookGrid).

2. Some source images from the Craft CMS export are genuinely low quality — small thumbnails from _eventbannersmall folder, not full-resolution. These need to be sourced from: publisher websites, Open Library Covers API, author/event promotional materials, or the original site's _eventbannerlarge folder.

Example: The TCB documentary poster could use the full promotional image from the production company instead of the Craft thumbnail.

Audit all ~347 images in src/assets/bookcovers/ and flag any under 400px wide as needing replacement.
close_reason: Done: 2x image sizing for Retina on both themes

title: Set up Decap CMS for curator content editing
description:
Set up Decap CMS (git-based) so curators Jeanne Theoharis and Robyn Spencer-Antoine can add/edit content without touching code. Decap commits directly to git, triggering Astro rebuilds.

Collections to configure:
- Events: title, date, season (spring/fall dropdown), year, speakers (relation widget to speakers collection), book covers (image list), eventbrite URL, description (rich text)
- Speakers: name, affiliation, image, email, twitter, homepage, bio (rich text)
- News: title, date, image, tags, body (rich text)
- Pages: title, body (rich text)

Editor UX goals:
- Adding a new season event should be 5 fields + description
- Speakers selectable from existing entries via relation widget
- Default values: seasonYear=current year, date=next first Thursday
- Image upload via drag-and-drop
- Preview templates showing formatted output

Auth: GitHub OAuth (repo collaborators) or Netlify Identity
Hosting: /admin route on the same Astro site
close_reason: Done: Decap CMS at /admin/ with events, speakers, news, interviews, pages collections. Editorial workflow, local backend for dev, git-gateway for production.
